title: Sustainability Fair 2021
description:
The 3rd Annual Sustainability Fair is organised by the Dr Kiran C Patel Centre for Sustainable Development at IIT Gandhinagar n Friday, March 26. The online Fair will be inaugurated by Shri Vijay Ramniklal Rupani, Chief Minister of Gujarat. The Fair will also feature several renowned speakers on Renewable Energy and Water Resources:

Magsaysay Award Winner Dr Rajendra Singh of Tarun Bharat Sangh
Dr Kalanithy Vairavamoorthy of the International Water Association
Dr Ashok Das of SunMoksha

The event offers opportunities for networking with various stakeholders, including government department officials, academicians and researchers, and sustainability officers from the industries. The Sustainability Fair is hosting Virtual Exhibitions by regional and national industries and organizations demonstrating ongoing sustainable development practices.

Exhibitors at the event include the International Water Association, UNICEF, International Desalination Association, The Energy and Resources Institute, Centre for Water Policy, Regulation and Governance at Tata Institute of Social Sciences, International Water Management Institute, Sardar Patel Renewable Energy Research Institute, WIN Foundation, Advanced Centre for Integrated Water Resources Management (ACIWRM), Sustain Impact, Water Digest, Centre for Environment Education, etc.
